column2: When an agent hands work to subagents, Flotilla keeps them in view.
Running subagents stay pinned under the thread's title, however far the conversation scrolls.
Two at once fold into one line. Open it, and each one shows the call it's on, and how long it's been going.
When they finish, each becomes a card in the thread, with how many calls it made, and how long it took.
Open one to see what it was asked, the calls it made, and its report.
Codex subagents get the same cards, and each one's answer stays in its card, not mixed into the reply.
OpenCode's too, with the task the agent gave each one.
Every agent in its own isolated VM, and every subagent in view. This is Flotilla.
